'''Pat Dinelle''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Montreal DPC]] on 18 August 2001 with Brangus, according to Eric George's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2879">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-21-montreal-18-08-01d2879/ montreal-18-08-01], DeckTech (Eric "Inspecta_Dek" George, 21 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-21-montreal-18-08-01d2879/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
